decision.explanation: Document d2 provides specific archival evidence (transcripts, letters dated 1955, yearbook photos) placing Wesson at Vanderbilt University in the mid-20th century, while Document d1 claims he attended the National University "Odesa Law Academy" from 1995 to 1999; these represent two distinct time periods and potentially conflicting accounts of the same individual's education, both supported by the provided text.
